findings.title: XSS via HTML Entity Encoding Bypass in /page?name parameter
findings.description: The /page endpoint reflects the 'name' GET parameter unsanitized inside an attribute. The server filters '(' and '`' characters, but HTML entities (( for '(' and ) for ')') bypass the filter. When the browser renders the page, it decodes the entities and executes the JavaScript. Payload: " onerror="alert('XSS') — this triggers alert('XSS') by breaking out of the img src attribute and using the onerror event handler with HTML-entity-encoded parentheses.
